scope: Native C11 Safetensors storage reader qualified for exact DeepSeek V4.1 Flash1017 EXL3 asset. This does not admit the model for inference or implement EXL3 numerical execution.
api: Caller-owned opaque init_file/init_buffer/free handle, immutable metadata sorted by UTF-8 names, metadata lookup, checked byte-range read. Native file reads use pread; buffer/WASM branch borrows memory. No data conversion or global mutable state.

checkpoint.scope: Native C metadata comparison across all48shards and bounded native pread byte comparisons against Python os.pread. Tensor bodies not fully decoded or hashed; no model-execution claim.

upstream_rust_conformance.scope: Randomized dtype/shape/name/JSON-order/padding/packed/empty tensor files; all metadata and complete raw tensor bytes agree with upstream Rust deserialize. Explicit C API limits NULstrings/rank32/unknownfields are excluded.

storage_types: 22 byte and packed types, including BF16, F8_E4M3, F8_E8M0, I16 trellis and I32 scalars. These are storage tags; quant numerical behavior remains owned by BnQuantFormatOps.
limits: embedded NUL strings and unknown tensor fields/types reject explicitly
Complete contiguous payload coverage required, including byte alignment for sub-byte types
Files/buffers must remain immutable while borrowed; I/O errors can partially fill a destination and return failure
next: Bind the multi-shard index and EXL3 component representation, qualify canonical MUL1 quant math against pinned upstream, then integrate exact40-layer architecture/Engram/routing semantics and bounded expert placement before model admission. Existing Flash and remaining CPU/Metal/performance scope stays open.
